# Slider

> Single-value or range control with branded and plain treatments.

This file matches the installed `slider` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/slider.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/slider.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/range-knobs`: `rangeKnobs`, types `RangeKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/slider`: `Slider`, types `SliderVariant`, `SliderValue`, `SliderProps`

## Composition

### Value control

Pass a number for one thumb or an array for a range: one thumb per entry, each named by thumbLabels.

```tsx
<Slider />
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useState } from "react";

import { Slider } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/slider";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

function Row({ label, children }: { label: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Text size="caption" weight="medium" tone="muted">
        {label}
      </Text>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function PrimitiveSliderExample() {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(40);
  const [plainValue, setPlainValue] = useState(65);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState(50);
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(40);
  const [savedVolume, setSavedVolume] = useState({ value: 40, changes: 0 });

  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <Row label="Default">
        <Slider aria-label="Default slider" value={value} onValueChange={setValue} min={0} max={100} />
      </Row>
      <Row label="Plain">
        <Slider variant="plain" aria-label="Plain slider" value={plainValue} onValueChange={setPlainValue} min={0} max={100} />
      </Row>
      <Row label="Plain, labeled">
        <Slider
          variant="plain"
          label="Zoom"
          value={zoom}
          onValueChange={setZoom}
          min={0}
          max={100}
          step={10}
          formatValue={(v) => `${v}%`}
        />
      </Row>
      <Row label="Range, one thumb per value">
        <Slider
          variant="plain"
          label="Price"
          defaultValue={[200, 600]}
          thumbLabels={["Minimum price", "Maximum price"]}
          min={0}
          max={1000}
          step={50}
          formatValue={(price) => `$${price}`}
        />
      </Row>
      <Row label="Disabled">
        <Slider variant="plain" aria-label="Disabled slider" value={30} disabled min={0} max={100} />
      </Row>
      <Row label="Vertical, committed on release">
        <Slider
          variant="plain"
          orientation="vertical"
          label="Volume"
          value={volume}
          onValueChange={setVolume}
          onValueCommitted={(committedVolume) => setSavedVolume((previous) => ({ value: committedVolume, changes: previous.changes + 1 }))}
          min={0}
          max={100}
          step={10}
          formatValue={(currentVolume) => `${currentVolume}%`}
          className="h-48"
        />
        <Text size="caption" tone="muted">
          <output aria-label="Saved volume">
            {savedVolume.value}% ({savedVolume.changes} changes)
          </output>
        </Text>
      </Row>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### range

- `--cui-range-level-warning-background`: `var(--warning)`
- `--cui-range-level-clip-background`: `var(--destructive)`
- `--cui-range-level-muted-background`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-range-level-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`
- `--cui-range-level-scale-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-range-indeterminate-size`: `40%`
- `--cui-range-indeterminate-animation-duration`: `calc(var(--duration-loop) * 1.5)`
- `--cui-range-track-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 2)`

- `--cui-range-thumb-inline-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3.5)`
